tools.name: audit_feed_lite
tools.description: FREE lite product feed hygiene scan of a product feed URL (XML, CSV, or JSON — auto-detected). Runs the same 20 checks as audit_feed but returns top-line results only: 0-100 score, A-F grade, disapproval-risk level, detected format, item count, check counts, and the titles of the top gaps — item-lev
